keyEvents.text: Delay in match (Salzburg).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Karen Muradyan (Ararat-Armenia) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Salzburg 0, Ararat-Armenia 0.
Second Half begins Salzburg 0, Ararat-Armenia 0.
Goal! Salzburg 1, Ararat-Armenia 0. Bartosz Mazurek (Salzburg) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Leandro Morgalla.
Gaoussou Diakite (Salzburg) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Salzburg 2, Ararat-Armenia 0. Bartosz Mazurek (Salzburg) right footed shot from outside the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Soumaïla Diabaté.
Substitution, Salzburg. Karim Konaté replaces Gaoussou Diakite.
Alexandros Malis (Ararat-Armenia) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Ararat-Armenia. Franca replaces Alioune Ndour.
Substitution, Ararat-Armenia. Bruno Pereira replaces Edgar Grigoryan.
Substitution, Salzburg. Nikolas Veratschnig replaces Leandro Morgalla.
Substitution, Salzburg. Damir Redzic replaces Edmund Baidoo.
Zhirayr Shaghoyan (Ararat-Armenia) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Ararat-Armenia. Zidane Banjaqui replaces Zhirayr Shaghoyan.
Substitution, Ararat-Armenia. Arayik Eloyan replaces Artur Serobyan.
Delay in match because of an injury Jesper Lindstrøm (Salzburg).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Zidane Banjaqui (Ararat-Armenia) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Salzburg. Umut Tohumcu replaces Yorbe Vertessen.
Substitution, Salzburg. Aboubacar Camara replaces Jesper Lindstrøm because of an injury.
Delay in match (Salzburg).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Ararat-Armenia. Armen Ambartsumyan replaces Karen Muradyan.
Penalty saved. Karim Konaté (Salzburg) right footed shot saved in the centre of the goal by Arman Nersesyan (Ararat-Armenia).
